raw_segments.text: So Satan spake, and him Beelzebub thus answered, Leader of those armies bright-witch, but T.H.,
If once they hear that voice, their liveliest pledge of hope in fears and dangers, heard
so oft in worst extremes, and on the perilous edge of battle, when it raged, in all assaults
their surest signal, they will soon resume new courage and revive, though now they lie
groveling and prostrate on Yawn Lake of Fire, as we are wile, astounded and amazed.
No wonder fallen such a pernicious height.
